description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_PackageImport class, which provides functionality to import modules into the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for parsing manifest files, validating zip packages, importing module components such as tables, blocks, fields, views, sharing access, events, actions, related lists, custom links, and cron tasks, and handling module dependencies and versions.

classes.name: Vtiger_PackageImport
classes.description: Class providing API to import modules into vtiger CRM, extending Vtiger_PackageExport, with methods for parsing manifests, validating packages, and importing various module components.

methods.name: Vtiger_PackageImport
methods.description: Constructor method, calls parent constructor.

methods.name: __parseManifestFile
methods.description: Parses the manifest.xml file from the zip archive to load module metadata.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the package type as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: xpath
methods.description: Evaluates an XPath expression on the module XML.

methods.name: xpath_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific XPath expression.

methods.name: isLanguageType
methods.description: Checks if the package is a language type package.

methods.name: isModuleBundle
methods.description: Checks if the package is a module bundle.

methods.name: getAvailableModuleInfoFromModuleBundle
methods.description: Returns list of modules in a module bundle.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the license text of the package.

methods.name: checkZip
methods.description: Validates the zip package by checking for manifest, language, and version dependencies.

methods.name: getModuleNameFromZip
methods.description: Extracts the module name from the zip package after validation.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name from the loaded manifest.

methods.name: __AddModuleFieldToCache
methods.description: Caches a module field instance for reuse.

methods.name: __GetModuleFieldFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached module field instance.

methods.name: initImport
methods.description: Initializes import process by unzipping relevant files.

methods.name: getTemporaryFilePath
methods.description: Returns a temporary file path for extraction.

methods.name: getDependentVtigerVersion
methods.description: Returns the required vtiger version for the module.

methods.name: getDependentMaxVtigerVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported vtiger version.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the module version.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to import a module from a zip file, handling module bundle sequences.

methods.name: import_Module
methods.description: Performs the actual import of a module, creating database entries and setting up components.

methods.name: import_Tables
methods.description: Imports database tables defined in the module XML.

methods.name: import_Blocks
methods.description: Imports blocks and fields for the module.

methods.name: import_Block
methods.description: Creates a block instance for the module.

methods.name: import_Fields
methods.description: Imports fields within a block.

methods.name: import_Field
methods.description: Creates a field instance and associates it with a block.

methods.name: import_CustomViews
methods.description: Imports custom views for the module.

methods.name: import_CustomView
methods.description: Creates a custom view/filter for the module.

methods.name: import_SharingAccess
methods.description: Sets default sharing access for the module.

methods.name: import_Events
methods.description: Imports event handlers for the module.

methods.name: import_Event
methods.description: Registers an event handler.

methods.name: import_Actions
methods.description: Imports actions (tools) for the module.

methods.name: import_Action
methods.description: Enables or disables a tool/action.

methods.name: import_RelatedLists
methods.description: Imports related list configurations.

methods.name: import_Relatedlist
methods.description: Creates a related list link between modules.

methods.name: import_CustomLinks
methods.description: Adds custom links to the module.

methods.name: import_CronTasks
methods.description: Registers cron jobs for the module.
